column8: Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Hash → ((ℤ → ℤ) → (ℤ → ℤ) → Prop) → Prop := fun H Indistinguishable => ∀ (cell : ℤ) (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (xs xs' : List ℤ), { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs, blinder := 0 }.Admissible → { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs', blinder := 0 }.Admissible → Indistinguishable (fun r => Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith H { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs, blinder := r }) fun r => Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith H { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs', blinder := r }
∀ {s : Minidregg.Pred.State} {v : Minidregg.Pred.Slot}, s.get v = Option.none → ∀ {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot}, v ∈ vs → s.getAll vs = Option.none
∀ {s : Minidregg.Pred.State} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {xs : List ℤ}, s.getAll vs = Option.some xs → xs.length = vs.length
∀ {s : Minidregg.Pred.State} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {xs : List ℤ}, s.getAll vs = Option.some xs → ∀ v ∈ vs, (s.get v).isSome = Bool.true

∀ (H : Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Hash) (s : Minidregg.Pred.State) (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot), Minidregg.Pred.hashEqHolds H s vs b c = Bool.true ↔ ∃ o, Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening s vs b c = Option.some o ∧ s.get c = Option.some (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith H o)

∀ {s : Minidregg.Pred.State} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {o : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening}, Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening s vs b c = Option.some o ↔ s.get Minidregg.Pred.hashEqCellSlot = Option.some o.cell ∧ s.getAll vs = Option.some o.values ∧ s.get b = Option.some o.blinder ∧ o.valueSlots = vs ∧ o.blinderSlot = b ∧ o.commitSlot = c ∧ o.Admissible
∀ (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get b = Option.none → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.false

∀ (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get "request/target" = Option.none → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.false

∀ {v : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot}, v ∈ vs → ∀ (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get v = Option.none → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.false

∀ (o : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening), o.Admissible → ∀ (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get "request/target" = Option.some o.cell → new.getAll o.valueSlots = Option.some o.values → new.get o.blinderSlot = Option.some o.blinder → new.get o.commitSlot = Option.some (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed o) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq o.valueSlots o.blinderSlot o.commitSlot) old new = Bool.true

∀ {vs vs' : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c b' c' : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {old new old' new' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs' b' c') old' new' = Bool.true → new.get c = new'.get c' → (∃ o, Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening new vs b c = Option.some o ∧ Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening new' vs' b' c' = Option.some o) ∨ Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed

∀ {vs vs' : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c b' c' : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {old new old' new' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs' b' c') old' new' = Bool.true → new.get c = new'.get c' → new.get "request/target" ≠ new'.get "request/target" ∨ vs ≠ vs' ∨ b ≠ b' ∨ c ≠ c' → Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed

∀ {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {old new : Minidregg.Pred.State}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true → ∀ v ∈ vs, (new.get v).isSome = Bool.true

∀ {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {old new old' new' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old' new' = Bool.true → new.get c = new'.get c → new.getAll vs = new'.getAll vs ∧ new.get b = new'.get b ∨ Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed

∀ {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {old new old' new' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old' new' = Bool.true → new.get c = new'.get c → (∀ v ∈ vs, new.get v = new'.get v) ∨ Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed
∀ {s s' : Minidregg.Pred.State} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {xs : List ℤ}, s.getAll vs = Option.some xs → s'.getAll vs = Option.some xs → ∀ {v : Minidregg.Pred.Slot}, v ∈ vs → s.get v = s'.get v

∀ (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.true ↔ ∃ cell xs r, new.get "request/target" = Option.some cell ∧ new.getAll vs = Option.some xs ∧ new.get b = Option.some r ∧ { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs, blinder := r }.Admissible ∧ new.get c = Option.some (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.digestWith Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.deployed { cell := cell, valueSlots := vs, blinderSlot := b, commitSlot := c, values := xs, blinder := r })

∀ (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State) (r : ℤ), new.get b = Option.some r → ¬(0 ≤ r ∧ r < 2 ^ 256) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.hashEq vs b c) old new = Bool.false
∀ (H : Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Hash), (Minidregg.Pred.HashEqHiding H fun x1 x2 => x1 = x2) → Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Collision H
¬Minidregg.Pred.HashEqHiding id fun x1 x2 => x1 = x2

∀ {s s' : Minidregg.Pred.State} {vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {b c : Minidregg.Pred.Slot} {o o' : Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening}, Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening s vs b c = Option.some o → Minidregg.Pred.hashEqOpening s' vs b c = Option.some o' → o'.cell = o.cell → s'.get c = s.get c → Minidregg.Pred.hashEqHolds Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.lengthHash s' vs b c = Minidregg.Pred.hashEqHolds Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.lengthHash s vs b c
Minidregg.Pred.HashEqHiding Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.lengthHash fun x1 x2 => x1 = x2
